name: yass
description: YARG song browser — sortable, filterable, searchable song list with now-playing, served alongside a YARG install

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.//demo: The static, serverless build published to GitHub Pages: a synthetic library, generated covers and a simulated now-playing feed, all of it under client/src/mock. `dev:demo` is the same thing on the dev server, for checking it locally without a YARG install.
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && npm run dist --workspace=desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test --workspace=desktop
